The '''''Planet Jumper''''' was a [[Crinya-class freighter|''Crinya''-class freighter]] that had served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for about a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]]. The ship was extensively modified during its lifetime with the Alliance, including additional hull plating and the mounting of triple [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. While the ship appears beat-up, the ''Planet Jumper'' is a reliable and sturdy ship. Due to an undiscovered quirk in the ship's control systems, the ''Planet Jumper'' handles better in atmosphere than in space. Additionally, the ship suffers from the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] bleeding energy prior to a jump, resulting in one of the ship's other systems such as maneuverability, [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], or weapons, going dead as the engines take the energy.<ref name="S" />
